yt_title: Zite vs Stackby: no credit meter 💸 #Shorts
yt_description:
Zite or Stackby? Zite builds apps with AI credits. On Stackby you edit apps visually as much as you like, on a deeper database with 100,000 workflow runs a month on Pro.

We compared Zite Business with Stackby Pro on databases, apps, workflows, interfaces and AI field agents.

Zite Business: $660 a year ($55/mo, billed annually).
Stackby Pro: $449 a year for 3 users.
That's 32% less.

Feature by feature
• Building & editing apps — Zite: AI credits (200 / month) · Stackby: visual builder, no credits
• Database — Zite: built-in tables for apps · Stackby: linked tables, lookups, rollups
• Views on your data — Zite: app screens · Stackby: grid, kanban, calendar, gallery
• Workflow runs / month — Zite: 50,000 · Stackby: 100,000
• Live API data & sync — Zite: via integrations · Stackby: API columns + sync connectors
• AI field agents in your data — Zite: uses credits · Stackby: bring your own AI key

Stackby plans (3 users included, billed annually)
• Economy: $149/year (7,000 records per database, 1,000 automation runs/month, interfaces)
• Business: $299/year (50,000 records, 25,000 runs/month, interfaces, sync connectors)
• Pro: $449/year (100,000 records, 100,000 runs/month, interfaces with custom domain, enterprise access)
Every plan includes AI, API columns and interfaces/portals.

👉 Try Stackby free: https://stackby.com/signup
